column1: # ZAP API scan rules: <rule id><TAB><IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL><TAB><reason>. A rule that is not listed keeps its default level,
# and a WARN or FAIL fails the pipeline. Every entry needs a reason.

column3: Non-Storable Content: intended, every answer of the API has Cache-Control: no-store (tokens and account data must not be cached)

CORP missing: the API is read by the website with CORS fetches from the origins in AllowedOrigins, which CORP does not govern; CORP only limits no-cors embedding of the JSON, which has no secret without the bearer token. A server header change is not needed for this
